description: This file defines the user interface and logic for the onboarding wizard in an iOS app for the OpenClaw project. It manages multiple onboarding steps including introductory screens, gateway connection methods (QR code scanning, manual setup), authentication, and success confirmation. It integrates with environment objects for app state, manages QR code scanning, and handles gateway connection workflows.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: An enum representing the different steps in the onboarding process, with helper properties for navigation and display titles.

classes.name: OnboardingModeRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for selecting an onboarding connection mode with a checkmark indicator.

methods.name: handleScannedLink
methods.description: Processes a scanned QR code or deep link and populates connection settings accordingly.

methods.name: openQRScannerFromOnboarding
methods.description: Prepares the onboarding view to open the QR scanner for gateway linking.

methods.name: advanceFromIntro
methods.description: Marks the first run intro as seen and proceeds to the next onboarding step.

methods.name: navigateBack
methods.description: Returns to the previous onboarding step.

methods.name: detectQRCode
methods.description: Detects and extracts a QR code message from image data.

methods.name: scheduleDiscoveryRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the gateway discovery process after a debounce delay.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a gateway using manual host and port inputs.

methods.name: retryLastAttempt
methods.description: Retries the last gateway connection attempt, optionally silently.
